description: Réseau de transport d’électricité (RTE) en Basse-Normandie is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geonormandie.fr. Georeferenced database of HT and THT works in Lower Normandy, of which Rte is a concessionaire and/or provides maintenance. This database contains the following geographical objects: electricity transmission lines HT and THT; supports (pylons, poles, gantries); the HT and THT processing stations. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Electricity transmission network (TEN) in Lower Normandy" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2015-09-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
